title: Heat Pumps are Not Hard: Here's what it will take to start pumping
summary: Technology Connections' long closing video in his heat pump series, arguing that adopting heat pumps is well within reach. It explains how they work and what it takes to start using them.
why: HN recommends the series as an enthusiastic, entertaining deep dive into residential heat pumps whenever heating or climate threads arise.

quote.text: If you want an (entertaining) deep dive into heat pumps, I can recommend Technology Connection's
